name: Aurorya
subtitle: Your birth chart, unfiltered
promotionalText: Your real birth chart, calculated to the degree, told in the tone you choose: gentle, blunt or expert. Share your card and compare with your crew.
description:
Aurorya calculates your real birth chart, then tells it in the tone you choose.

SERIOUS CALCULATIONS
Sun, Moon, Rising, planets, houses and aspects are calculated from your birth date, time and place, with an ephemeris engine checked against NASA reference data. No generic horoscope: your own sky.

THREE TONES
• Moon, gentle: to reassure and shed light.
• Mars, blunt: to laugh while hitting the mark.
• Saturn, expert: to understand with rigor.

YOUR ROAST, ON A CARD TO SHARE
Three punchlines that sum up your chart, each anchored in a real placement. A card made for your stories, with or without your first name.

YOUR BIRTH CHART WHEEL
Explore your sky planet by planet, or as a readable list.

EVERY DAY
Your sign's daily horoscope and a question to reflect on.

YOUR GROUPS
Create a group with friends, your partner, family or colleagues, and discover everyone's role and the duos that form.

AURORYA PREMIUM
Your full chart reading in eight chapters (love, mind, ambition, inner world, shadow side…), detailed group readings and more groups.

Aurorya is for entertainment and self-reflection. It does not predict the future and does not replace medical, legal or financial advice. Ava, Aurorya's astrologer, is an artificial intelligence.
